finding.summary: Non-manifold closed shell: four straight edges (x = +-1.225 mm, z = 1.08 mm) each bound four faces, where two lobes of the switch touch along a line. MANIFOLD_SOLID_BREP requires each edge to bound two faces, so the retained-boundary reader refuses it as invalid. OpenCascade's BRepCheck does not test manifoldness and accepts it.

entries.message: imported boundary: Imported boundary is not a valid closed solid

finding.summary: Contains a SHELL_BASED_SURFACE_MODEL with open shells beside its solids. The product has no surface-body concept, and importing only the solids would drop part of the model, so the file is refused as unsupported. Surface bodies are deferred to CAD-363 by product decision.
